topic: Someone discovers their friend has been lying about their job
text: I can't shake the image of him, smiling as he talked about his job. I thought he was thriving, but it turns out, none of it was real. I keep replaying our conversations, wondering how I missed it. I should have asked more, should have been a better friend. Now, every time I think about it, I feel a heavy weight in my chest. I want to reach out, to apologize somehow, even though I’m not sure what for. Maybe for not being there enough, for not seeing what was right in front of me.
